LanguageData.RimLTC_HospiceCare_NoCare_Desc: Nobody tends to the elder's senescence. It progresses at full speed, the elder soils their surroundings and they will pass away neglected.
LanguageData.RimLTC_HospiceCare_NoMeds_Desc: Doctors turn, wash and comfort the elder without using medicine. Slows senescence a little, but at best the colony will remember a regretful passing.
LanguageData.RimLTC_HospiceCare_HerbalOrWorse_Desc: Doctors use herbal medicine (or none) to ease pain. Slows senescence noticeably and can earn a peaceful passing.
LanguageData.RimLTC_HospiceCare_NormalOrWorse_Desc: Doctors use industrial medicine (or worse). Slows senescence the most. Together with a comfortable bed and a clean room it can earn a transcendent passing.\n\nGlitterworld medicine is never used for hospice care. Wounds and diseases still follow the medical care policy.
LanguageData.RimLTC_HospiceCare_HeaderTip: Left-click: set the hospice care policy for everyone in this list.\nRight-click: sort.
LanguageData.RimLTC_CascadeComplication: {PAWN_labelShort}'s failing body could not cope any longer: {1}.
